ink_pipeline.windows: SS10 per-ayah write windows mapped from the SS17 schedule (units->dp proportional); a 0.002 pen-lift at EVERY internal line break (ayah 7 spans three lines in the 7-line block -> its SS10 span [0.526,0.580] splits into three segments); ayah rings are analytic circle instances drawn by the same pen clock (angular w from the top, leftward first); wet trail dp 0.045 closed-form; E5 = spatial smoothstep dw 0.012 with overscanned t so stroke starts hide at t=0 and ends land at t=1
ink_pipeline.architecture: ink evaluates in a sheet-space RT pass (src/ink/inkPass.ts, 1597x2048 RGBA8, re-rendered when p changes); the parchment material samples ONE texture and composites with EXPLICIT mul/add lerps
three_r185_gotchas: TSL mix() with a texture-derived factor inside MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial colorNode/roughnessNode silently kills the light integration (value-independent, even factor 0) — write lerps as mul/add
float32 DataTextures (textureLoad) in the physical material silently break the pipeline (env lost or mesh vanishes, no console error) — all lookup data ships as fixed-point RGBA8 byte pairs
browsers premultiply PNG RGB by alpha on decode/upload — atlas alphas must be 255, no data channel in A
an RT written by a fullscreen quad reads back v-FLIPPED vs the quad's uv on WebGPU — the ink pass evaluates at 1-uv.y (probed empirically)

text_pipeline.layout: v1.4.1 classical justified TRUE-RECTANGLE variants (2026-08-25, PENDING USER CHOICE): continuous flow, minimum-unevenness DP line breaking, kashida-only block justification. Balanced elongation: <=1.5 em per joint, slack spread over 2-3 joints per line (sin/shin teeth, then before-final joints, then flat bases of sad/dad/kaf; the Allah ligature and lam-alif are excluded - tested on BARE letters, diacritics sit between them); basmalah = full-em own line filled by the single uncapped sin elongation. No orphan close: the final line carries >=3 words and ends on the ayah-7 marker (rosette-filler fallback implemented, NOT needed - both variants close fully justified).
text_pipeline.leading_rule: v1.4.2: min per-x ink-over-ink clearance (shaped glyph boxes) >= 0.35 em between adjacent lines, x1.10 for relief shadows; pitch = smallest satisfying value, CLAMPED to the text band [0.150, 0.865]; ink block centered in the band. STATUS: the rule pitch (2.33 em) does not fit the band at ANY legal em for either variant - feasibility windows are empty in both directions (8line: caps-justifiable only at em >= 0.051, rule would fit only at em ~0.039; 7line: caps >= 0.046, rule ~0.043). Both variants are frozen at band-floor em 0.052 with the maximum in-band pitch: RULED by review 2026-08-25: band-max leading — sheet, margins, and em band hold; these frozen variants stand.
